Name: Obelisk Overhaul Inspired By Eemi Seasonal Victorian
Author: thewapakalypse
Description:
[font=Arial][b][u]
Disclaimer:[/u] I do not own the art within these images. I[/b] edited graphics to make these Obelisks (via Pixlr Online), but I don't consider the art mine at all. I used Stardew Valley item PNGS and Eemie's art to create these images. They deserve ALL the credit. Please see eemie's page for her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/891]original mod[/url]﻿. Eemie, if you're looking at this, please feel free to have me take this down!  Also, big shout out to mangoruffy and her mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2496]CP Seasonal Victorian Cabin (Inspired by Eemie's Seasonal Victorian Buildings)[/url]as she inspired this project and I used much of her coding as a base! 



[b]What this mod does:[/b]
[list]
[*]Replaces Base Game Obelisks (Water, Earth) with a Victorian-style seasonal Obelisk Tower that matches Eemie's original seasonal Victorian buildings (specifically the silo!) via Content Patcher!
[*]Provides a manually installable recolor (PNG file) of the Desert Obelisk (by CasCattyCat) and Deep Woods Obelisk (by Max Vollmer) that you can swap out yourself with each season! This is a bit more work, but it is an easy and quick copy and paste! If anyone has a way to add seasonal support to either of these items, please let me know so I can try to work that into this! :)
[/list]
[u][b]What you need to use this:[/b][/u]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Arial]This mod is for Stardew's 1.3[/font]
[*][font=Arial]You'll need the beta version of SMAPI which you can find [url=https://smapi.io/]here[/url].[/font]
[*][font=Arial]This is a Content Patcher mod, so you will also need to download the beta of that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=description]here[/url].[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Desert Obelisk Mod : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2021 ]download here[/url]﻿.[/font]
[*]Deep Woods (Includes Deep Woods Obelisk) : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2571]download mod here[/url]﻿.
[*]A few seconds to do some quick copy & pasting!
[/list][font=Arial]
[u][b]How to Install:[/b][/u]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Arial]First install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI here[/url]﻿ which will require you to launch the game through the API. Follow the Player Guide on the website for instructions.[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Install Content Patcher by PathosChild [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]here[/url]﻿.[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Make sure you have the following installed if you wish to use Modded Obelisks from your other mods:[/font]
[*][font=Arial][list]
[*][font=Arial]Desert Obelisk Mod : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2021]download here[/url]﻿.[/font]
[*]Deep Woods (Includes Deep Woods Obelisk) : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2571]download mod here[/url]﻿.
[/list][/font]
[*][font=Arial]Unpack the Zip Folder Into Your Documents. [/font]
[*][font=Arial]The Following Folders Are Included....Options Included in the following Folder Names:[/font]
[/list][font=Arial]
[/font]


[u][b][size=4][center]TO INSTALL WATER AND EARTH OBELISK (BASE GAME) ONLY:[/center]
[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*][font=Arial][size=3][b]Folder:[u] [CP] Obelisk Overhaul Inspired By [/u]Eemi[u] Seasonal Victorian_Base Game Only[/u][/b] [/size]= Uses content patcher to replace the Earth and Water (base game) Obelisks in your game! Simply place this single folder in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder and you are finished!!![/font]
[/list][font=Arial][size=3][b][u]



[/u][/b][/size][/font][b][u][size=4][center]TO INSTALL MODDED OBELISKS: [/center]

For Additional Mod Creator Obelisks (Deep Woods and Desert) you need the other 2 folders:


[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=3]Folder: [u]Obelisk Overhaul Inspired By [/u]Eemi[/size][/b][size=3][u][b] Seasonal Victorian_Manual_Install_Deep Woods Mod by Max Vollme[/b][/u]r [/size]= Manually installable Deep Woods Obelisk that you must change yourself each season. Only a simple copy and paste is required, but more detailed instructions (it is super easy!) are included in the folder's "read me".
[/list][font=Arial]
[/font][list]
[*][b][size=3]Folder:[u] Obelisk Overhaul Inspired By [/u]Eemi[/size][/b][u][b][size=3] Seasonal Victorian_Manual_Install_DesertObelisk Mod by CatCattyCat[/size][/b][/u] = Manually installable Desert Obelisk that you must change yourself each season. Only a simple copy and paste is required, but more detailed instructions (it is super easy!) are included in the folder's "read me".
[/list][font=Arial]




[/font][font=Arial]Similar to mangoruffy, this is my first mod ever. I don't know exactly what I'm doing, but it worked in game (at least on Winter). I don't have access to the desert obelisk or deep woods one yet, so I'll see about those in the future, but I see no reason why a Manual Install such as this wouldn't work!!![/font]
